Query.Query_Text:
select
 meta_name  as "Name",
 technical_status as "Status",
 exceptions_count as "Exceptions Count", 
 executed_on  as "Executed On", 
 executed_by as "Executed By" ,
 duration as "Duration" ,
 source_count as "Source Count",      
 target_count as "Target Count"
from
 (
  select
   *
  from
   (
    SELECT
     A.scenario                       ,
     A.scenario_session               ,
     A.type                           ,
     A.log_time                       ,
     A.job_id                         ,
     B.metaName meta_name             ,
     B.comments                       ,
     B.status AS technical_status     ,
     B.status_changed_time            ,
     B.status_changed_user            ,
     B.user_status                      AS user_status     ,
     B.mismatch_count                   AS exceptions_count,
     B.log_time                         AS executed_on     ,
     B.[user]                           AS executed_by     ,
     B.scenario + '_COMPARE_EXCEPTIONS' AS view_name       ,
     B.records_watch_listed             AS watch_list_count,
     round(A.duration, 3)               as duration        ,
     B.source_count                     as source_count    ,
     B.target_count                     as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     session_header B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type = 'FDR'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
     A.scenario                       ,
     A.scenario_session               ,
     A.type                           ,
     A.log_time                       ,
     A.job_id                         ,
     B.metaName meta_name             ,
     B.comments                       ,
     B.status AS technical_status     ,
     B.status_changed_time            ,
     B.status_changed_user            ,
     B.user_status                         AS user_status     ,
     B.unique_exception_count              AS exceptions_count,
     B.log_time                            AS executed_on     ,
     B.[user]                              AS executed_by     ,
     B.scenario + '_VALIDATION_EXCEPTIONS' AS view_name       ,
     0                                     AS watch_list_count,
     round(A.duration, 3)                  as duration        ,
     B.dataset_count                       as source_count    ,
     0                                     as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     validation_session_header B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type = 'VALIDATION'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
     A.scenario                       ,
     A.scenario_session               ,
     A.type                           ,
     A.log_time                       ,
     A.job_id                         ,
     B.meta_name                      ,
     B.comments                       ,
     B.match_flag AS technical_status ,
     B.status_changed_time            ,
     B.status_changed_user            ,
     B.user_status AS user_status     ,
     B.fail_count  AS exceptions_count,
     B.executed_on AS executed_on     ,
     B.executed_by                    ,
     '-'                  AS view_name                 ,
     0                    AS watch_list_count          ,
     round(A.duration, 3) as duration                  ,
     0                    as source_count              ,
     0                    as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     tdr_session_header B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type = 'TDR'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
     A.scenario          ,
     A.scenario_session  ,
     A.type              ,
     A.log_time          ,
     A.job_id            ,
     B.metaName meta_name,
     '-' AS comments     ,
     CASE
     WHEN
      B.failed = 0
     THEN
      'P'
     WHEN
      B.failed = 1
     THEN
      'E'
     END technical_status       ,
     NULL       AS status_changed_time,
     '-'        AS status_changed_user,
     '-'        AS user_status        ,
     0          AS exceptions_count   ,
     B.log_time AS executed_on        ,
     case
     when
      B.[user] = ''
     then
      'BATCH_USER'
     ELSE
      B.[user]
     END AS executed_by   ,
     B.view_name          ,
     0                    AS watch_list_count,
     round(A.duration, 3) as duration        ,
     0                    as source_count    ,
     0                    as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     (
      SELECT
       X.*
      FROM
       LOG X
      INNER JOIN
       (
        SELECT
         scenario,
         session ,
         Max(log_time) log_time
        FROM
         log
        GROUP BY
         scenario,
         session ) Y
      ON
       (
        X.scenario    = Y.scenario
       AND X.session  = Y.session
       AND X.log_time = Y.log_time )
      WHERE
       X.state = 'QUERY_CHAIN_END' ) B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type     = 'QUERYCHAIN'
    and B.state = 'QUERY_CHAIN_END'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
     A.scenario          ,
     A.scenario_session  ,
     A.type              ,
     A.log_time          ,
     A.job_id            ,
     B.metaName meta_name,
     '-' AS comments     ,
     CASE
     WHEN
      B.failed = 0
     THEN
      'P'
     WHEN
      B.failed = 1
     THEN
      'E'
     END technical_status       ,
     NULL       AS status_changed_time,
     '-'        AS status_changed_user,
     '-'        AS user_status        ,
     0          AS exceptions_count   ,
     B.log_time AS executed_on        ,
     case
     when
      B.[user] = ''
     then
      'BATCH_USER'
     ELSE
      B.[user]
     END AS executed_by   ,
     B.view_name          ,
     0                    AS watch_list_count,
     round(A.duration, 3) as duration        ,
     0                    as source_count    ,
     0                    as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     (
      SELECT
       X.*
      FROM
       LOG X
      INNER JOIN
       (
        SELECT
         scenario,
         session ,
         Max(log_time) log_time
        FROM
         log
        GROUP BY
         scenario,
         session ) Y
      ON
       (
        X.scenario    = Y.scenario
       AND X.session  = Y.session
       AND X.log_time = Y.log_time )
      WHERE
       X.state = 'INGEST_RESTAPI_END' ) B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type     = 'RESTAPI'
    and B.state = 'INGEST_RESTAPI_END'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT
     A.scenario        ,
     A.scenario_session,
     A.type            ,
     A.log_time        ,
     A.job_id          ,
     B.meta_name       ,
     NULL AS comments  ,
     CASE
     WHEN
      B.errored_objects > 0
     THEN
      'E'
     WHEN
      B.failed_objects > 0
     THEN
      'F'
     ELSE
      'P'
     END  AS technical_status   ,
     NULL AS status_changed_time,
     NULL AS status_changed_user,
     CASE
     WHEN
      B.errored_objects > 0
     THEN
      'E'
     WHEN
      B.failed_objects > 0
     THEN
      'F'
     ELSE
      'P'
     END                AS user_status     ,
     B.exceptions_count AS exceptions_count,
     B.executed_on      AS executed_on     ,
     case
     when
      B.executed_by is null
     then
      'BATCH_USER'
     else
      B.executed_by
     end                  as executed_by     ,
     '-'                  as view_name       ,
     0                    AS watch_list_count,
     round(A.duration, 3) as duration        ,
     0                    as source_count    ,
     0                    as target_count
    FROM
     job_header A
    INNER JOIN
     (
      SELECT
       scenario                 ,
       session                  ,
       meta_name                ,
       Sum(duration) duration   ,
       Max(log_time) executed_on,
       Max(userid) executed_by  ,
       Sum(
        CASE
        WHEN
         result = 'F'
        THEN
         1
        ELSE
         0
        END ) failed_objects,
       Sum(
        CASE
        WHEN
         result = 'E'
        THEN
         1
        ELSE
         0
        END ) errored_objects,
       Sum(
        CASE
        WHEN
         result = 'F'
        THEN
         exceptions_count
        ELSE
         0
        END ) exceptions_count
      FROM
       BULK_VALIDATION_TABLES_HEADER
      GROUP BY
       scenario,
       session ,
       meta_name ) B
    ON
     (
      A.scenario            = B.scenario
     AND A.scenario_session = B.session )
    WHERE
     A.type = 'BDV' ) as TotalJob
  WHERE
    job_id in (~~USR_Jobs_To_Monitor##) and 
   (
    log_time BETWEEN DATEADD(HOUR,-4, GETDATE()) and DATEADD(HOUR,+7, GETDATE())) ) as newtable
ORDER BY
 "Executed On" desc
